title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Share of Return Shipping Fees
content:
Marlowe & Finch Unlimited members pay a reduced share of the Returns & Exchanges return shipping fee, or none. The plan share follows the customer's Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership.

| Customer's Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership | Share of the return shipping fee paid |
|---|---|
| A plan that covers return labels, in status trial or active | Nothing |
| Any other plan, in status trial or active | 0.8 of it (80 percent) |
| No plan, or a plan in any other status | In full |

The share multiplies the return shipping fee before the fee is rounded to the cent; a share of nothing makes the fee zero.

Examples (hypothetical):

- A customer in the trial period of a plan that covers return labels: nothing.
- A customer on an active plan that does not cover return labels: a scheduled pickup fee of 9.95 becomes 7.96.
- A customer whose plan has been cancelled: in full.
